from openpyxl import load_workbook
from pathlib import Path
import os

input_path = Path('/mnt/data/spreadsheet/399-14/1_399-14_input.xlsx')
output_path = Path('/mnt/data/outputs/399-14_0_fdb2b5a4/1_399-14_output.xlsx')

wb = load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb['Sheet1']

# The allowed write range is N7:O23. Apply the stated split only within that range.
# Column N contains recorded hours. If hours > 40, N becomes 40 and the excess is placed in O.
# If hours <= 40, leave N unchanged and leave O unchanged.
for row in range(7, 24):
    n_cell = ws.cell(row=row, column=14)  # N
    o_cell = ws.cell(row=row, column=15)  # O
    val = n_cell.value
    
    # Preserve formulas/blank/non-numeric values unchanged; operate on numeric hour entries.
    if isinstance(val, (int, float)) and not isinstance(val, bool):
        if val > 40:
            excess = val - 40
            n_cell.value = 40
            o_cell.value = excess

output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
print(f"Saved to {output_path}")

from openpyxl import load_workbook

in_ws = in_wb['Sheet1']

ok = True
print("Verification for Sheet1!N7:O23")
for row in range(7, 24):
    orig_n = in_ws.cell(row=row, column=14).value
    orig_o = in_ws.cell(row=row, column=15).value
    new_n = out_ws.cell(row=row, column=14).value
    new_o = out_ws.cell(row=row, column=15).value
    
    if isinstance(orig_n, (int, float)) and not isinstance(orig_n, bool) and orig_n > 40:
        exp_n = 40
        exp_o = orig_n - 40
    else:
        exp_n = orig_n
        exp_o = orig_o
    
    row_ok = (new_n == exp_n) and (new_o == exp_o)
    if not row_ok:
        ok = False
    print(row, "orig:", orig_n, orig_o, "=> out:", new_n, new_o, "expected:", exp_n, exp_o, "OK" if row_ok else "FAIL",
          "types:", type(new_n).__name__, type(new_o).__name__)

print("OVERALL", "PASS" if ok else "FAIL")
assert ok
